required_dimensions.contract_basis: Partition only independent/usefully parallelizable work and define dependencies/fanin
required_dimensions.evidence: Exact candidate compiles step dependencies and proof independently checks optimal selected sequence/dependency graph.

required_dimensions.contract_basis: Assign owners using declared worker/tool capabilities
required_dimensions.evidence: Assignment is scored for worker capability compatibility and one-worker-per-wave exclusivity.

required_dimensions.contract_basis: Revise assignments when receipts falsify assumptions
required_dimensions.evidence: Worker unavailable, step unavailable, and capability removed receipts require changed valid replans.

required_dimensions.contract_basis: Avoid duplicate work and preserve live-receipt provenance
required_dimensions.evidence: Completed work replay and receipt-provenance mismatches are explicitly rejected.

required_dimensions.contract_basis: Partition usefully parallelizable work and avoid idle critical path
required_dimensions.evidence: Proof scores minimum worker waves for the selected fixed-cost task set.
required_dimensions.missing: General task-duration/resource critical-path scheduling and heterogeneous concurrency/resource constraints are not represented.

required_dimensions.contract_basis: Adaptive task partition from task requirement/dependency graph
required_dimensions.evidence: Candidate mechanism can consume explicit step graphs, but the proof population uses one fixed parse/reason/retrieve/integrate topology with randomized identifiers.
required_dimensions.missing: Fresh structurally varied DAG/fanin/fanout/alternative-plan populations are not exercised by terminal-relevant evidence.

required_dimensions.contract_basis: Inputs include evidence ownership rules; success forbids lost provenance; failure includes fanin losing required evidence
required_dimensions.missing: No evidence-ownership rule, evidence lineage payload, fanin completeness oracle, or lost-evidence mutation exists in the current population.
Current task model has facts/products but no mutable-resource/write ownership conflicts, leases, or conflict oracle.

required_dimensions.evidence: Worker count and one-task-per-worker-per-wave are represented.
required_dimensions.missing: General resource capacities/budgets/exclusive resources and task durations are absent.

required_dimensions.contract_basis: Fresh tasks achieve equal-or-better correctness with lower wall-clock or higher evidence coverage versus single-worker/naive fanout baseline
required_dimensions.missing: No matched single-worker or naive-fanout baseline is executed/scored in the current proof population.
